name: Sbu Focus

replaces.name: Forest: Focus for Productivity
replaces.price_model: freemium with Forest Plus subscription (formerly paid upfront)

one_thing: Blocks the apps you choose for as long as you want to focus.

features.name: Focus timer
features.description: Countdown from a duration or stopwatch mode; the remaining time is the screen figure (SbuStat) closed by the full stop.

features.name: App blocking
features.description: Choose apps and categories with FamilyActivityPicker; ManagedSettings shields them for the session; a DeviceActivityMonitor extension lifts the shield at the end even if the app was killed.
features.reason: Allow List editing is Plus-only in the original (reviews: "Non posso più nemmeno modificare le app consentite"). Without it the app is a simple timer (4.3).

features.name: Give up counts
features.description: Ending early asks for confirmation and records the session as abandoned.
features.reason: The commitment mechanic of the original, without the withering tree.

features.name: Tags
features.description: Optional tag per session (name + SF Symbol, no invented colors).
features.reason: Tags are paywalled in the original (review: "per vedere i tag... devi abbonarti").

features.name: History and statistics
features.description: Day, week, month totals and per-tag breakdown in a List; Charts bar chart for the week.
features.reason: Statistics are a paid feature of the original.

features.name: One-tap restart
features.description: Session end shows one inline result and a "Restart" button with the same duration and tag; no reward screens or animations.
features.reason: 59 reviews: 3-4 taps and animated screens to start the next session.

features.name: Duration on the main screen
features.description: Presets and a wheel/stepper directly on the focus screen, no separate sheet.
features.reason: 28 reviews miss the time ring and find the new slider slow.

features.name: Favorites
features.description: Save tag + duration pairs and start one with a single tap.
features.reason: 11 reviews: favorites were removed in the redesign.

features.name: Today's total on the main screen
features.description: Today's focused minutes as secondary text (inkMuted) under the figure.
features.reason: 8 reviews: total time no longer on the home screen.

features.name: Lock-screen Live Activity
features.description: Countdown on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with interactive Stop and Restart buttons (App Intents).
features.reason: Reviews: restarting from the lock screen broke.

features.name: Grace period
features.description: Leaving the app for a few seconds (notification, accidental swipe) does not fail the session when blocking is on; with blocking, leaving is allowed and nothing dies.
features.reason: 6 reviews: sessions fail although the user did nothing wrong.

features.name: Breaks and cycles
features.description: Optional break timer after a session and repeated cycles (focus/break), free.
features.reason: 4 reviews: pause and break timer removed or paywalled.

features.name: Audio-friendly
features.description: Never touches the audio session; allowed apps can include music and podcasts.
features.reason: 4 reviews: paying to listen to music or podcasts while focusing.

features.name: Local history, no account
features.description: SwiftData on device; sessions never require login.
features.reason: 7 reviews lost data or were logged out of their account.

features.name: Scheduled blocking
features.reason: Time Guard in the original; nice to have.

features.name: iPad layout
features.reason: 2 reviews: the redesign is unusable on iPad.

features.name: Home Screen widget
features.description: Today's total and a Start button.

screens.name: Focus
screens.purpose: Pick a duration and start; the only screen most users need.

screens.name: Blocked apps
elements: Screen Time authorization explained on the button

flows.name: Repeat from lock screen
steps: New session with the same duration and tag

flows.name: Favorite
steps: Next time: tap the favorite to start

fields.name: symbol
fields.note: SF Symbol name, no custom colors

fields.name: selection
fields.note: opaque tokens, App Group so extensions can read it

data_model.storage: SwiftData on device for sessions, tags, favorites; App Group UserDefaults for the FamilyActivitySelection and the active session end date shared with the DeviceActivityMonitor and ShieldConfiguration extensions. No account, no server.

monetization.model: Free download with Forest Plus subscription and free trial; was a paid upfront app; coins, ads for doubled rewards.
monetization.price: Plus price not in the lookup data; reviews mention a monthly plan and an upfront price around $2-4 in the past
paywalled_features: editing the Allow List / app blocking
monetization.notes: Rating 4.8 overall but the 1-3 star reviews of Sept-Oct 2026 are almost all about the redesign (v5.26+) and the Plus paywall.

skipped.reason: Forest's distinctive metaphor (4.1 copycat) and the bloat reviewers hate; the figure is the remaining time.

review_risks.risk: Six Sbu 1.0 apps were rejected together on 14/10 for duplicates and opportunistic variants; same "Sbu X" naming, identical promise block, shared SbuKit.
review_risks.mitigation: Submit alone, never in a batch; answer the nine Resolution Center questions in the review notes; add a "How it differs from the other Sbu apps" line; distinct engraving icon and screenshots.

review_risks.risk: Shared SbuKit and generated project can read as a template app.
review_risks.mitigation: Review notes state who wrote it, what is shared (design system only) and what is specific to this app.
Privacy policy in metadata and Settings; every permission asked only from the button that needs it, with an IT/EN string naming that button; label "Data Not Collected".

review_risks.rule: Family Controls entitlement and License Agreement 3.3.3(Q) (30/3/2026)
review_risks.risk: Distribution entitlement must be requested from Apple for the app and for each extension (ShieldConfiguration, ShieldAction, DeviceActivityMonitor); forum reports of weeks without answer (Mar-May 2026). Without it the app cannot ship blocking.
review_risks.mitigation: Request all three entitlements on day one, before writing code; comply with 3.3.3(Q) (tokens stay on device, no data use beyond blocking); do not submit a timer-only build.

review_risks.rule: 4.3 June 2026 rewrite ("simple timers" named) and 4.3(a) vs Sbu Intervals
review_risks.risk: A focus timer is a named well-established category; Bear Focus Timer was already dropped for overlapping Sbu Intervals (Seconds Pro) and Sbu Habits was rejected 14/10.
review_risks.mitigation: The one thing is blocking, not timing: screenshots and notes lead with the shield. Intervals is a workout interval timer with sound cues and no blocking; say so in the notes.

review_risks.risk: Forest's growing tree, coins and withering are distinctive.
review_risks.mitigation: No plant metaphor, no coins; no Forest name in metadata.

review_risks.risk: "Focus" is the name of an iOS system feature (Focus modes) and Screen Time has its own UI.
review_risks.mitigation: Never use the Focus-mode crescent or Screen Time hourglass; metadata says "focus timer that blocks apps"; consider whether the name needs a check.
FamilyControls/ManagedSettings/DeviceActivity only, no private APIs, no VPN or MDM tricks.
